exposure: Mode of delivery (Cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 180 primiparous women with singleton pregnancies at or beyond 37 weeks gestation
finding: Mode of delivery (Cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery) did not significantly affect antral follicle count or anti-Mullerian hormone levels six months postpartum.
mod_finding: Antral follicle count and anti-Mullerian hormone, six months after delivery, are not affected by delivery mode.
